# Saahil Pandya

> Saahil Pandya is a product engineer in Ahmedabad, India, who takes AI products from spec to shipped code. He is a product manager at Motadata, leading AI across ServiceOps, an enterprise ITSM and IT asset management platform. He is open to conversations about product engineering and AI engineering roles.

He defines the problem, writes the requirements, and builds the systems behind them, so trade-offs on cost, reliability, and model quality are decided by someone who understands both sides.

## Projects

- [AI Studio](https://www.motadata.com/capabilities/ai-workforce): ServiceOps' agentic AI suite, in production at Motadata. IT teams deploy pre-built AI agents and manager-orchestrated AI teams with no code. Agents are grounded on each customer's knowledge base through RAG, with PII masking on input and output and a test-and-preview step before go-live. Documentation: https://docs.motadata.com/serviceops-docs/admin-section/ai/ai-studio/
- [Prism](https://github.com/saahilll/Prism): An OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway that puts one endpoint in front of multiple model providers. Per-team budgets and rate limits, failover across providers, difficulty-based routing to cheaper models, and a semantic cache. Python, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, React, Docker.
- [Prolifo](https://github.com/saahilll/prolifo): A hybrid RAG engine that ranks candidates against job descriptions and explains every result. Semantic search (ChromaDB) and keyword search (BM25) combined with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, must-have requirements enforced before scoring, and a 0 to 100 score with a plain-language reason.
- [Vero](https://github.com/saahilll/vero): A real-time chat application with personal and group messaging, file sharing, and live presence. Python, Django Channels, HTMX, Redis.
- [Little Garden](https://github.com/saahilll/little_garden): An e-commerce application with a product catalog, category filtering, a session-aware cart, and an order workflow. Python, Django.

## Strengths

- End-to-end ownership: from problem discovery and PRDs to architecture, implementation, tests, and launch.
- Applied AI engineering: agentic systems, RAG, LLM gateways, and evaluation against baselines.
- Production judgement: designs for cost control, failover, governance, and data privacy from day one.
